title: Dying in 'the mall', and my "fun room" recurring dream

position.relative_to: above the sub space/parallel universe below

qualities.raw_description: “main floor still doing whatever, interacting with each other, playing around” ; “the main area is so poorly illuminated anyway”

locations.location_name: below the 'mall' (sub space / parallel universe one story down)

position.relative_to: one story down from the mall; directly below the main floor

qualities.raw_description: “parallel universe of what's up above, but with no light” ; “no ceiling (or maybe more like a glass ceiling?)… I can see straight through from below” ; “the light above illuminates the area… hardly enough to see around here” ; “There's never anybody else down in this space with me, unless they died too” ; “I can hear everything going on up above, but I can't interact with them; they don't hear me”

position.relative_to: sometimes leads to a sub space directly below it after death

qualities.raw_description: “sort of like a McDonalds PlayPlace, with tubes you crawl through, equipment to run around on, and ball pits” ; “pretty big room” ; “no floor… when you look down through the bars and nets, it's just a black void” ; “can't fall through because it's all safed off by the play equipment” ; “no windows to the outside” ; “windows on one wall that face into a very backroom esque office like environment” ; “only one light is ever on, so it's dim, but bright enough that you can see the whole room” ; ceiling varies: “warehouse ceiling… purling and high bay lights” OR “drop ceiling… recessed 2x4 troffer lights”

locations.location_name: sub space/parallel universe directly below the fun room

qualities.raw_description: “end up down below, once again, in a sub space/parallel universe directly below the fun room” ; variants: “just a giant ball pit” OR “all rope swings and I have to hold on so I don't fall into the void”

locations.location_name: backroom-esque office environment (seen through windows from the fun room)

position.relative_to: visible through windows on one wall of the fun room

qualities.raw_description: “windows on one wall that face into a very backroom esque office like environment”

connections.qualities: Triggered by dying: “anytime I do die, what happens is I get sent below the 'mall'; literally like one story down”
Triggered by dying in the fun room: “end up down below… directly below the fun room”

boundaries.description: Fun room has “no floor”… looking down through “bars and nets, it's just a black void”; “can't fall through because it's all safed off by the play equipment.”

Ceiling absent or “glass ceiling” with people above walking; dreamer “can see straight through from below”; attempts to interact upward fail: “they don't hear me… I try to throw things at them… they don't acknowledge it.”
“There are no windows to the outside on the walls or ceiling.”
Variant sub space: “all rope swings and I have to hold on so I don't fall into the void.”

interactions.description: From below, dreamer observes and hears people on the main floor above; light from above shines down through a glass-like ceiling/floor interface.

entities_involved.description: People “up on the main floor still doing whatever, interacting with each other, playing around.”

interactions.description: Dreamer attempts to get attention from people above by throwing things; they do not respond and cannot hear the dreamer.

entities_involved.description: People above “don't hear me… don't acknowledge it.”

interactions.transaction_blocker: No response/acknowledgment from people above; inability to interact across the glass-ceiling/floor separation.

interactions.description: Dreamer is in the fun room with relatives or friends.

entities_involved.description: “some of my relatives” present in the fun room.

interactions.description: Repeated deaths occur in the fun room; causes vary across dreams (examples include suffocating on a ball in the ball pit; strangling on a rope).
In one variant of the below-fun-room sub space, the environment is rope swings and the dreamer has to hold on to avoid falling into the void.
Sometimes the dreamer is given a “second chance at life up above” and told to be more careful; later dies again (sometimes immediately, sometimes after a while).

entities_involved.description: Described as “God… he gives me a second chance and tells me to be more careful.”

extraction.extraction_notes: Multiple dream episodes/variations are described (mall main floor vs below-mall sub space; fun room; below-fun-room variants). Exact visit order and exact connection mechanism (stairs/elevator/etc.) not specified; movement is described as being ‘sent’ one story down after dying.
